职位目标

  • 借助行内各种渠道,进行新客户开发,参与行内外组织的客户推介活动,积累客户资源
  • 为支行或分行营业部新客户提供客户开户服务和维护,日常咨询方面的需求,增加客户在我行的资产占比,以达到银行预期的业务和服务目标
  • 发展成为银行的丰盛理财经理储备人才

主要职责

渠道开发和拓展合格丰盛理财客户

  • 开拓挖掘新客户获取渠道（如战略合作伙伴，客户推荐，行内活动等），为我行新增合格丰盛理财客户。
  • 维护和优化现有渠道质量，主动探索深化与渠道合作伙伴关系，在拓展新客工作中实现高效协同。
  • 负责新客户开发的全流程：对潜在客户进行定向触达和资质筛选，为新客户开立账户，完成申请和相关文档。
  • 达成银行下达的各项销售任务，达到销售目标，为团队整体增长指标做出贡献。

协作式客户关系管理

  • 与客户经理紧密合作，与潜在客户积极互动，主动收集客户洞察（如风险偏好，财务目标等），确保客户交接顺畅和持续支持。
  • 向客户引介我行全球财富管理解决方案，突出贴合其财务目标的价值主张。
  • 主动处理和跟进客户的要求和查询，按照银行服务标准提供及时有效的解决方案，维持良好的客户满意度和留存率。

审计和合规控制

  • 遵守银行的政策、标准、操作准则/规程、安保及内部控制和合规措施，尤其是分支机构当地的操作规程。
  • 遵守由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定，尤其是那些适用于销售过程的规则和规定。

职责管辖范畴

  • 丰盛理财业务发展经理向丰盛理财业务发展团队经理汇报，并需负责达到和超越本行所分配之各项销售指标。

教育背景和相关工作经验要求

教育经历

  • 拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑
  • 对外资银行工作抱有热忱

工作经验

  • 有相关销售经验和客户开发经验者优先

专业技能要求

  • 技术知识: 具备主动高效的客户沟通技巧，擅长通过专业化，场景化沟通话术
  • 多重任务: 能够驾驭多个优先事务，保持敏锐的关注和精力水平，管理时间，以获得积极的成果
  • 产品知识: 具备银行有关产品和服务知识者优先

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Schedule:

Contract (Fixed Term)

Employee Status:

Full time

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Manager AI Initiatives.

Business: Finance COO

Job ID:58831

Principal Responsibilities

The Person is responsible for developing and managing the infrastructure required for the products. The Engineer will be responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining the cloud computing systems and networks, as well as developing and managing tools to automate the process. Also, to setup monitoring and observability of systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Leadership in transforming the Treasury Technology organisation into a highly-skilled, customer-centric value stream
  • Develop exciting career pathways that attract the best engineering candidates to the organisation
  • Establish a team of highly-skilled engineers that will then cross-pollinate best practice and engineering excellence across the organisation
  • Inspire the organisation to embrace innovation and help plan its innovation strategies
  • Design modernized organization structure and overall ways of working to accelerate transformation to product-oriented organization
  • Work as a trusted advisor to influence senior executives on transformation strategy and support the strategy implementation
  • Actively engage with business and operation teams, support value stream alignment within the organization
  • Assess team skill and capability maturity, define and implement training plan to match team and personal improvement roadmap
  • Introduce industrial best practices (e.g. DORA, SPACE framework) to build engineering excellence team
  • Coach DevSecOps improvement to uplift team's Mode-2 delivery maturity
  • Support management team to build 'blameless' culture, encourage experimentation and learn-from-failure
  • Coordinate innovation incubation events (e.g. Hackathon) to develop innovation climate within team
  • Coach delivery PODs' retrospectives to build continuous improvement mindset into DNA
  • Define and implement measurement to provide accurate visualization on team's delivery values
  • Coach team on building effective feedback loop with customers/business, incorporate customer feedback to evolve product
  • Own employee happiness survey, manage voice of employee to increase team happiness
  • Promote team's achievement to wider organization, internally and externally, to build the brand

What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role

  • University Degree (or above) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English is a must
  • Willing to move career towards a hands-on full stack engineering lead is a must
  • Demonstrable 7-10 years of commercial experience on developing both backend service and frontend UI solutions and capabilities of guiding and mentoring team members to develop high available and secured elegant full web (including backend and frontend) solutions
  • Hands-on understanding of LLM “agents” and agent workflows (tool use, planning, memory/state, evaluation/guardrails) and how to apply them to real software engineering problems
  • Practical experience building Agents with LangGraph (or equivalent frameworks) and also experience of implementing coding agents (e.g., code generation + validation loops, unit/integration test execution, static analysis, CI/CD integration) to produce robust, reliable outputs
  • Abilities to translate business level requirements to system level components or blocks, to review the deliverables from other team members and to work in diverse global teams.
  • Proven working experience on micro frontends, deep knowledge of the web front end framework and technologies like Node.js, React.js, javascript, css, bootstrap, html5.
  • Experience of developing web data visualization by using opensource or self-developed libraries like the Highchart, e-chart, Apache superset or ag grid. Any experience of customizing from coding level of open source solution like Apache superset will be a big plus
  • Develop exciting career pathways that attract the best engineering candidates to the organisation
  • Support management team to build 'blameless' culture, encourage experimentation and learn-from-failure
  • Coordinate innovation incubation events (e.g. Hackathon) to develop innovation climate within team
  • Coach delivery PODs' retrospectives to build continuous improvement mindset into DNA
  • Define and implement measurement to provide accurate visualization on team's delivery values
  • Coach team on building effective feedback loop with customers/business, incorporate customer feedback to evolve product
  • Own employee happiness survey, manage voice of employee to increase team happiness
  • Promote team's achievement to wider organization, internally and externally, to build the brand

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Any frontend experience like miro frontend or React development experience will be a bug plus
  • Any GCP certifications will be a big plus
  • Any experience of well-known engineering community contribution will be a big plus.
  • Any certification on architecture or programming will be a plus
  • Any knowledge/certification on K8s, Kafka, Kong Gateway or equivalence will be a plus

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

ln:4463192481.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Designs and implements robust technical solutions that enable critical business operations and enhance customer experience. Ensures system reliability, security, and performance standards are met while driving innovation and operational efficiency. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures that support the bank's digital transformation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Java
  • Spring/SpringBoot
  • Restful API

Other Skills

  • Docker/K8s
  • Postgre/DB2/Oracle
  • Maven/Gradle
  • DevOps/ADO

Motivations

  • Environment: Collaborative, matrix environments where building relationships across functions is essential for success Dynamic settings with competing priorities that require strong organizational and time management skills Inclusive team cultures that value diverse perspectives and encourage open dialogue
  • Outcomes: Delivering high-quality solutions that directly impact business objectives and client satisfaction Contributing to process improvements that enhance team efficiency and reduce operational risk Building sustainable systems and practices that create long-term organizational value]
  • Challenges: Complex problem-solving that requires both analytical thinking and creative approaches Stakeholder management situations requiring influence without direct authority Technical challenges that push the boundaries of current capabilities and require continuous learning
  • Growth: Opportunities to develop both technical depth and business breadth Mentoring and knowledge-sharing that contributes to team capability building Exposure to emerging technologies and industry best practices

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.
  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Java application development.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree or above.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

The Senior Relationship Manager is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Senior Relationship Manager also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Expand a portfolio of accounts with varying/complex financial needs with the objective of revenue growth and good credit quality in line with Citi’s credit standards, policies and processes
  • Identify customer needs and recommend solutions to address these needs, such as financing, streamlining of cash management operations, foreign currency solutions, etc.
  • Cross-sell banking products, including cash management, trade finance, trade services, structured trade products, foreign exchange, commodities, fixed income, loans (including syndicated, bilateral) and capital market products
  • Responsible for all credit aspects of the relationship including annual reviews, early problem recognition and remedial management
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Comprehensive knowledge of credit analytics and financial modelling
  • Proven expertise in Risk assessment and valuation

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Job Summary

The Engineering Lead will provide end-to-end technical leadership for AI-enabled products and capabilities across WRB. The role is accountable for solution architecture, engineering delivery, governance and production readiness, ensuring that AI solutions are secure, scalable, explainable, observable and aligned with the Bank’s technology, risk, Responsible AI and regulatory standards. The role will collaborate across product, engineering, architecture, data, platform, risk and partner teams to deliver sustainable business and customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver solution intent and application designs, produce clear and comprehensive design and solution intent documents.
  • Support business in appropriate sequencing of the backlog, refinement, and rationalization through a technical lens.
  • Oversee the implementation of microservices architecture where applicable
  • Design APIs and ensure they are secure, scalable, and well-documented according to standards
  • Manage and mitigate technical risks in the delivery.
  • Present Solutions to the architecture review forum.
  • Align with technology architects on the target solution design to minimize technical debt.

  • Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement the necessary security controls tailored to the specific delivery or process. Identify Applicable Security controls by engaging with Security Champion

  • Define measurable AI acceptance criteria covering accuracy, groundedness, unsupported outputs, safety, traceability, tool use, latency, reliability and business suitability.
  • Ensure AI solutions integrate with enterprise platforms, data and business systems through secure, reusable and well-governed patterns.
  • Own production readiness for AI services, including resilience, capacity, performance, monitoring, incident management, support models, runbooks, recovery and operational acceptance.
  • Govern technology partners and vendors across scope, technical dependencies, deliverable acceptance, code ownership, documentation, knowledge transfer and handover.

Business

  • Develop and drive application strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Domain Tech Lead.
  • Develop and maintain the AI engineering roadmap, aligned with enterprise AI strategy, reusable platform capabilities, target architecture and technical-debt priorities.

Processes

  • Regularly reviews squad metrics in regards to Predictability, Quality, Squad Sentiment and supports the team to better value delivery.
  • Work with chapters to promote quality engineering, technical craftsmanship and drive solution standardization and service reusability.
  • Establish AI engineering lifecycle practices covering automated evaluation, controlled model, prompt and configuration changes, regression testing, production monitoring and feedback-driven improvement.

People & Talent

  • Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives
  • Provide technical mentoring, uplift AI engineering capability and influence engineering standards across squads and the wider engineering community.

Governance

  • Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production
  • The controls cover: Requirements, Architecture (see Architecture Review Forum below), Security (see Cyber Security Services below), Development, Testing, IT Resilience, Service Level Management, Tech Operations & Support, Release Management, SW Configuration Management
  • Ensure compliance with Responsible AI, model governance, data usage, explainability, human oversight and AI risk-assessment requirements, retaining evidence for audit and approval.
  • Apply AI-specific security controls covering identity propagation, least-privilege access, sensitive-data handling, prompt and response protection, secure model and tool access, secrets management and misuse prevention.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Product Owners; Domain Technology Leads; Architects; Engineering Squads; Data and AI Platform Teams; Cyber Security; Responsible AI; Model Risk; Compliance; Technology Operations; and Technology Partners.

Skills And Experience

  • Enterprise AI and agentic solution architecture; LLM integration; orchestration; retrieval-augmented generation; context and state management
  • Agile product delivery and cross-functional engineering leadership
  • Cloud-native AI engineering and architecture
  • Python and Java backend engineering; REST APIs; data and integration engineering
  • AI evaluation, observability, traceability and operational monitoring
  • DevSecOps, automated delivery, identity, security and data governance
  • Experience delivering secure, explainable, traceable and human-governed AI solutions, preferably in banking or another regulated industry.

Citi Commercial Bank offers its clients the convenience, a global banking network, thought leadership and global financial capabilities of Citi. We deliver extensive industry knowledge, local expertise and dedicated service support to Mid-Market companies, with an international footprint. We are focused on providing banking and financial solutions to our clients across 5 key growth industries - Business & Professional Services, Industrials, Digital, Technology & Communications, Consumer and Healthcare.

The primary responsibility of the Associate will be, in cooperation with the Senior Relationship Managers, servicing the banking & financing needs of international Mid-Market clients, deepening existing client relationships and acquiring & onboarding new commercial banking clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Build relationships with Citi network and operational teams, becoming one of the key contacts for clients’ requests, internal requests/escalation and resolution.
  • Support Senior Relationship manager in management of assigned portfolio of clients.
  • Work closely with Senior Relationship Managers to ensure we provide a 'Client First' approach and help to deliver outstanding day to day banking & operational support to our Mid-Market clients.
  • In cooperation with Senior Relationship Manager calls on clients and maximise ‘One Citi’ client experience, by proactively leveraging and sharing Citi’s market leading insights, global network and solutions.
  • Monitor and support products’ implementation processes, clients on-boarding process and manage sales CRM platform.
  • Liaise with Relationship Associate to ensure adherence to global KYC (Know Your Customer) standards during the onboarding process and, on an ongoing basis, ensuring the appropriate compliance deliverables are met.
  • Develops and maintains strong ties with Commercial Banking teams across the globe, in particular CCB colleagues working across the same sector vertical, CCB colleagues supporting subsidiary businesses overseas (Commercial Subsidiaries Group). Collaborate and work closely with various product teams (cash sales, trade finance, markets, corporate finance), Underwriting / Risk teams.
  • Work with Senior Relationship Managers to analyse client relationships, risks & opportunities, assists with credit application write-up, financial spreading, deal structuring, returns calculation, documentation review & preparation. Administrate the credit relationship of clients, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes.
  • Understand key commercial banking processes & solutions, including Transactional Banking, FX, Trade, Treasury, Working Capital and Lending products.
  • Support Senior Relationship Managers on solutioning assessment, preparation of pitch books and meeting materials, assists with new clients’ acquisition.
  • Work collaboratively with key internal stakeholders across CCB, share best practice across teams in order to deliver 'best in class' relationship management to new and existing clients.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years of experience
  • Previous banking experience
  • Working within Commercial/Corporate banking is desirable.
  • Experience in a Client Relationship role or client facing role.
  • Sales, presentation and communication skills. Focus on first class service quality.
  • Analytical and credit skills
  • High level of self-motivation
  • Knowledge of general banking processes, general understanding of commercial banking solutions
  • Ability to build & develop strong client relationships.
  • Effective collaboration skills with Senior Relationship Managers and Commercial Banking partners
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft and CRM applications

  • Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

 Responsibility:

  • Strong team player with risk & compliance awareness, self-motivation and focus.
  • Prior channel working experience in Guangdong region is preferred.
  • Hold AMAC Fund Practitioner Qualification Certificate.
  • 3年及以上基金、证券、银行投顾/客户经理相关金融从业经验优先；
  • 扎实的金融专业功底，熟悉国内公募基金行业发展现状，认同公司企业文化与价值观；
  • 具备公开路演宣讲能力，优秀的表达能力、内外部跨方协调能力，可承受较强工作压力；
  • 富有团队协作意识，具备风险合规意识，自驱力强、做事专注；

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering(AI Research Lead).

Why join us?

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

The Opportunity

This role is a strategic technical leader responsible for setting the AI research agenda, leading the development of advanced models and methods, and translating research into practical business value. The role combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence with strong people leadership, stakeholder engagement and responsible innovation.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Set the AI research vision and roadmap in line with business priorities.
  • Lead research into advanced AI, machine learning and generative AI methods.
  • Translate research outcomes into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
  • Manage, mentor and grow a high-performing team of AI researchers and engineers.
  • Collaborate with product, technology, risk, legal and data stakeholders.
  • Establish robust standards for model quality, explainability, fairness and governance.
  • Publish findings, protect intellectual property and represent the organisation externally.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Have very good track record of hands-on coding and project delivery
  • Strong education and technical background or research capabilities
  • Demonstrate great sense and understanding of AI industry trends and updates
  • Willing to work at high pace to conduct investigations and generate reports
  • Ability to translate research into scalable business solutions
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and strategic thinking

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics (Semantics Layer Engineer).

Business:CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 64611

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and implement semantic models for key domains, including customer/entity, onboarding journeys, credit exposures, limits, collateral, risk ratings, portfolio hierarchies, and performance measures.
  • Define and govern KPIs/metrics (e.g., onboarding turnaround time, KYC SLA adherence, application drop-off, approval rate, exposure at default, utilisation, arrears/delinquency, portfolio concentration, risk-adjusted returns), with documentation and lineage.
  • Translate business requirements into standard measures and conformed dimensions to ensure cross-domain consistency (e.g., customer, product, legal entity, booking location, time, risk grade).
  • Implement data quality and reconciliation controls to ensure metric correctness against source-of-truth platforms.
  • Optimise semantic performance and cost through appropriate modelling patterns, aggregation strategies, and incremental refresh approaches.
  • Apply security controls (RBAC/ABAC), row/column-level security and auditing to support controlled access to sensitive onboarding and credit data.
  • Operate the semantic layer in production: CI/CD, monitoring, incident triage, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Product Owners, Analysts, Risk and Operations stakeholders to drive adoption and consistent usage.

Requirements

  • Establishing “one agreed definition” for critical onboarding, credit and portfolio KPIs used across squads.
  • Reducing time spent reconciling numbers across reports, dashboards and AI outputs.
  • Enabling scalable self-serve analytics with clear, discoverable, versioned metric definitions.
  • Maintaining a stable, performant semantic layer with strong controls and auditability.

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience designing semantic layers for regulated domains (KYC/AML, credit risk, portfolio analytics).
  • Patterns for making semantics consumable by GenAI/agents (metric APIs, definition citations, grounded responses).
  • Familiarity with common semantic tooling (dbt semantic/metrics, LookML, Power BI Tabular, Cube/AtScale or similar).

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，

通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：

  • 厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
  • 匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承

  • 产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；

工作职责

  • 代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
  • 通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
  • 确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。

任职要求

  • 本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
  • 3年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者或其他行业5年以上销售或销售管理经验
  • 善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
  • 积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
  • 渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
  • 具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
  • 具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

The Corporate Salesperson is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities:

  • Sell separate account services or finance products directly to Corporate clients
  • Will help team to service clients in the buying and selling of securities, derivatives, FX and commodities
  • Help drive the team's developed strategy across specified product lines
  • Aid to achieve specified goals in both market and wallet share for the identified client franchise
  • Originate and execute meaningful and landmark transactions
  • Will independently and/or jointly work within business product to achieve the strategic growth and market share we are aiming for
  • Partner closely with other key businesses and functions to ensure proper product deployment based on understanding of client
  • Help foster an environment of collaboration through interfacing with appropriate internal partners to enhance share of mind with clients, increase dialogue and to deliver on expertise
  • Understand and analyze clients’ businesses and exposures to provide best suited sales solutions in full coordination with all relevant business partners
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Previous experience in client-facing roles with proven track record on growing and maintaining relationships through value added service and commercial skills
  • An entrepreneurial approach for business origination and developing new relationships
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

The overall objective of this role is to ensure the seamless delivery of investment strategies and advisory services to our public and private clients.

  • Develop new relationships, cement current relationships and share existing relationships with Citi colleagues

ln:4488114664.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
  • 扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
  • 根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
  • 向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
  • 配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English

Job Summary

  • We are seeking an experienced Development Lead to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable trading control systems that power Standard Chartered’ s digital banking platform. Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with DEV, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

  • Application Design, Architecture
  • Software Development
  • Leadership
  • AI

Qualifications

  • [8+ years of experience in development with strong Java expertise, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

ln:4489573352.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Payment Operations Specialist ensures the accurate, timely, and controlled execution of payment processing, clearing, cash management, and account maintenance activities that support the bank's transaction banking services. The role is accountable for delivering reliable operational outcomes, maintaining data integrity, and supporting seamless transaction processing across client and internal service channels.

The role contributes to business performance by ensuring payment transactions are processed in accordance with regulatory requirements, operational procedures, and service-level commitments. It plays a key role in managing operational risk, maintaining effective controls, resolving transaction exceptions, and safeguarding the integrity of customer and account information.

Working closely with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Service Delivery teams, the role supports operational resilience, client satisfaction, and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve service quality.

Key Responsibilities

Payment Processing & Transaction Delivery

  • Execute payment, clearing, and cash management transactions accurately and within agreed service standards to support reliable client outcomes.
  • Validate transaction instructions and customer information to ensure processing accuracy and reduce operational risk.
  • Investigate, resolve, and escalate payment exceptions, reconciliation breaks, and processing issues to minimise service disruption.
  • Deliver consistent operational performance against quality, productivity, and turnaround-time objectives.

Cash Management & Data Integrity

  • Maintain customer, account, product, and operational reference data to support accurate transaction processing and service delivery.
  • Execute account maintenance, billing, pricing, and related operational activities in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Ensure transaction records are complete, accurate, and appropriately documented to support auditability and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify, investigate, and address data-quality issues that may affect operational performance or client service.

Risk, Compliance & Control Management

  • Apply operational controls that mitigate financial, regulatory, and operational risks across payment-processing activities.
  • Execute activities in accordance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and operational procedures.
  • Escalate incidents, control weaknesses, processing errors, and potential breaches promptly to support risk mitigation.
  • Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and control assessments by providing accurate operational evidence and documentation.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve transaction-processing efficiency, service quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support automation, digitisation, and workflow-enhancement initiatives that simplify operations and reduce manual effort.
  • Contribute to process reviews that strengthen controls, reduce processing risks, and improve client outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging operational risks and recommend practical improvements to operating procedures.

Stakeholder & Service Management

  • Collaborate with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure effective operational support.
  • Communicate operational issues, service impacts, and resolution progress to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Support a client-focused service culture by responding effectively to operational enquiries and service requests.
  • Contribute to resolving cross-functional issues that affect transaction processing or service performance.

Skills And Experience

Priority skills

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Settlement Management
  • Operations Management
  • Quality Assurance
  • Regulatory Compliance

Other Skills

  • Cash Management
  • Payment Processing
  • Payment Schedule
  • Service Delivery
  • Data Management
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Risk Management

Motivations

  • Building trusted, long‑term relationships that deliver sustainable, risk‑adjusted growth.
  • Aligning products, regions and stakeholders around clear strategic priorities.
  • Applying sector‑ and segment‑specific knowledge and judgment to solve complex client problems and create value, leveraging data and AI‑enabled insights to deepen client understanding, sharpen focus and drive commercial impact.

Qualifications

  • Experience in transaction banking, cash management, payments, or financial services environments with high transaction volumes.
  • Exposure to regulated operational environments with strong control, compliance, and risk-management requirements.
  • Experience working across operational teams and stakeholder groups to resolve processing issues and service impacts.
  • Exposure to process improvement, automation, or operational-efficiency initiatives within banking or financial operations.
  • Experience balancing operational priorities while maintaining service quality, accuracy, and service-level commitments.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Who We Are Looking For

Reporting to an AVP, the Officer is responsible for delivering end-to-end fund administration services, overseeing several team members and ensuring team compliance with operating policies, procedures and guidelines in the timely completion of accurate Net Asset Valuations (NAV). They are also responsible for team development and/or staff management. In addition, the Officer will also be involved with and drive projects such as the provision of management reporting, BCP and Risk initiatives, as well as ad hoc project work with the objectives of enhancing client satisfaction or winning operational efficiencies.

Why This Role Is Important To Us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a recognized industry leader in providing fund accounting, fund administration, and risk services to hedge funds, private markets, and other alternative investment vehicles. AIS delivers fully integrated solutions across the investment lifecycle, providing clients with comprehensive front-, middle-, and back-office support to meet the evolving needs of institutional investors.

Join us if making your mark in the alternative investment industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Hedge Fund Accounting Officer you will be responsible for

Net Asset Value Operations

  • Maintain primary portfolio and accounting records for a variety of onshore and offshore hedge fund partnerships and corporations, trading in all types of investment securities and products
  • Familiar with end-to-end NAV processes and in-depth business knowledge on Hedge products and systems
  • Calculate daily/weekly/monthly Net Asset Valuations for the purpose of reporting to investors and processing of investor subscription and withdrawal activity
  • Allocate gains and losses amongst investors and calculate and accrue management and performance fees payable to hedge fund managers
  • Prepare tax lot accounting reports and schedules and assist in preparation of annual financial statements
  • Prepare fund performance reports including annual summaries and weekly return estimates
  • Prepare ad hoc portfolio, performance and fee reports as requested by Home-sites
  • Maintain primary accounting records for hedge fund management companies


Communication and Stakeholder Contact

  • Provide support for and effectively communicate both homesite, local managers and teams
  • Manage relationships with internal clients (other State Street offices outsourcing to Hangzhou) at appropriate levels to ensure continued confidence in the Hangzhou office. This might include late night and early morning conference calls across all time zones.
  • Responsible for key operational metrics, SLAs, KPIs etc.
